about: Get a single-entry visa to look for a job in the UAE for 120 days, without a UAE host.
aliases: Look for a job UAE visa
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Job exploration visa, 120 days. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Stay of 120 days on a single entry, without a UAE host
Passport valid for at least 6 months
The page does not say how long the visa is valid for entry or whether it can be extended
documents: Other papers only if ICP cannot fetch them from government records
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
